criteria.description: the conflict must be caused by the control change rather than coincide with it
criteria.reason: causality between a signal phase and an encounter is not expressible in this vocabulary; it is what the blind mechanism-provenance judge is for

originalIntent: This category is where the corpus was weakest. A signal phase change is not by itself an encounter: the census records C13.control as having no conflict mechanism at all, and 93% of its cells failed C3 clearance. The rubric therefore requires a genuine two-actor conflict in addition to whatever the control does. Bands are pre-registered from published test protocols, not fitted to observed results.
title: Traffic control: a control change must PROVOKE a second actor, not merely occur
